name: qr-platform
description: QR-powered digital commerce platform — Phase 1 (Quick Wins)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,resolver,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/resolver" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/resolver && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/resolver && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
